description: Draft a city-owned thing for the world aisle. Free and valid for about one hour. Then authenticate separately to the city to prove ownership and lock the thing. A seller may hold one pending world draft. Before creating another, activate it, cancel it, or wait for expiry. Exactly these fields, nothing else: title, description, preview, price_usdc, seller_wallet, tags, thing_id.

description.description: trimmed, then must contain 1-4000 characters measured as UTF-16 code units

preview.description: trimmed, then must contain at most 4000 characters measured as UTF-16 code units; empty is allowed

price_usdc.description: greater than 0 and at most 10000; rounded to 6 decimal places

seller_wallet.description: your Base wallet where the city sends the buyer payment

tags.description: values are lowercased and trimmed; empty and duplicate values are removed; each is truncated to 40 UTF-16 code units; the first 8 remain

items.description: at most 40 UTF-16 code units before normalization

thing_id.description: the positive integer ID of the thing you own in the city

title.description: trimmed, then must contain 3-120 characters measured as UTF-16 code units

name: draft_world
title: Draft World
